You can update Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion pipelines using the AWS Management Console,
the AWS CLI, or the OpenSearch Ingestion API. OpenSearch Ingestion initiates a blue/green
deployment when you update a pipeline conﬁguration. For more information, see the section
called “Blue/green deployments for pipeline updates”.
